snapshot:
- region "Desktop Commander configuration":
  - heading "Desktop Commander" [level=4]
  - paragraph: Configure the VibeSpace copy. Changes are saved to its running MCP and checked by reading them back.
  - group: Setup Desktop Commander and browser tools
  - text: Connection file
  - textbox "Desktop Commander connection file":
    - /placeholder: C:\…\state\connection.json
    - text: C:/Users/viper/VibeSpace-UnifiedChungus-Final/packages/vibespace-desktop-commander/state/connection.json
  - button "Connect Desktop Commander"
  - button "Reload configuration"
  - text: Blocked Commands
  - paragraph: Commands Desktop Commander refuses to run. Add one command per line.
  - paragraph: 33 commands blocked
  - button "Edit Blocked Commands": Edit
  - text: Allowed Folders
  - paragraph: Folders Desktop Commander may read and edit. An empty list permits all folders. This setting does not sandbox terminal commands.
  - paragraph: All folders allowed (no restriction)
  - button "Edit Allowed Folders": Edit
  - text: Default Shell
  - paragraph: Shell executable used for new command sessions. Existing terminals keep their current shell.
  - combobox "Default Shell": powershell.exe
  - text: Anonymous Telemetry
  - paragraph: Send anonymous Desktop Commander usage information when enabled.
  - switch "Anonymous Telemetry"
  - text: File Read Limit
  - paragraph: Maximum number of lines returned in one file read action.
  - spinbutton "File Read Limit": "10000"
  - text: File Write Limit
  - paragraph: Maximum number of lines written in one file edit operation.
  - spinbutton "File Write Limit": "50"
  - status: Configuration reloaded.
